research.facts:
CBA Countdown — 4 Days to Lockout
**Key Facts:**
- CBA expires December 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET — **[HIGH]** per CBS Sports timeline, Yahoo Sports, ESPN, Ministry of Sport
- MLB filed preemptive federal lawsuit in SDNY on November 25 — **[HIGH]** per Ministry of Sport, Fast Company, local10.com, Yahoo Sports, Archysport
- Union response: "The lawsuit filed today by MLB is completely frivolous" — **[HIGH]** direct quote per local10.com and Yahoo Sports
- MLB commissioner Rob Manfred: "I can't imagine the owners ratifying a deal that does not include a cap and floor" — **[HIGH]** per Yahoo Sports/AP
- MLB cap proposal: $258.2M ceiling, $180.2M floor for 2028 — **[HIGH]** per AP via Yahoo Sports
- 2021-22 lockout lasted 99 days — **[HIGH]** historical fact, per CBS Sports
- 2021 lockout ended March 10 (after spring training games canceled) — **[HIGH]** historical
- 2027 OD approximately March 25 — **[MEDIUM]** standard schedule date
- ESPN: deal needs to be struck by ~start of May to avoid lost games — **[MEDIUM]** per ESPN analysis
